name: multiview-demo
// targets: MediaPackage V2 Dynamic MultiView demo stack. Parent template.yaml + one nested stack per source (source.yaml). Deploys with aws cloudformation package (uploads the child template) then deploy; linted with cfn-lint (W3002 is expected: the parent's nested-stack TemplateURLs are resolved by package).

deploy.command: aws cloudformation package --template-file template.yaml --s3-bucket "${MULTIVIEW_ARTIFACTS_BUCKET:-demo-videos-trackflix-live}" --s3-prefix cfn-multiview --output-template-file .packaged.yaml --region us-west-2 && aws cloudformation deploy --template-file .packaged.yaml --stack-name "trackflix-multiview-$STAGE" --parameter-overrides Stage="$STAGE" --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND --tags Project=trackflix-live Owner="$STAGE" Name="trackflix-multiview-$STAGE" --region us-west-2 --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
